My hands are part of my job."},{"end":295,"speaker":"S1","start":291,"text":"So you've been out of work since August 22?"},{"end":308.1,"speaker":"S2","start":296.1,"text":"Yes. The adjuster has also been calling me asking for a recorded statement about my injuries. Should I do it?"},{"end":398.8,"speaker":"S1","start":384.4,"text":"No. Please don't give a recorded statement or sign any medical authorization they send you. I have a stack of them."},{"end":442.05,"speaker":"S1","start":434.45,"text":"Bring them all, along with any explanation of benefits from your health insurance. Who is your health insurer?"},{"end":445.85,"speaker":"S2","start":442.65,"text":"Blue Harbor Health, through my husband's employer."},{"end":461.9,"speaker":"S1","start":446.7,"text":"Okay. Does that matter?"},{"end":499.95,"speaker":"S1","start":493.95,"text":"It does. It shows the impact on your daily life. Write that down too."},{"end":504.15,"speaker":"S2","start":500.55,"text":"How long does a case like this take?"},{"end":529,"speaker":"S1","start":505,"text":"It depends mostly on your medical treatment. We generally don't want to settle until we know whether you'll need surgery, because that changes the value significantly. The statute of limitations for personal injury here is two years, so we have until August 22, 2027 to file a lawsuit if we can't settle. We won't wait until the last minute."},{"end":536.1,"speaker":"S2","start":530.1,"text":"The adjuster told me the van's insurance only covers so much. Is that true?"},{"end":557.9,"speaker":"S1","start":536.7,"text":"Every policy has limits, and commercial fleets often carry higher ones, sometimes with an umbrella policy on top. We'll ask for the policy limits in our letter. If your damages exceed the limits, your own underinsured motorist coverage may also apply. Do you know if you have that on your auto policy?"},{"end":562.35,"speaker":"S2","start":558.75,"text":"I don't know. My husband handles the insurance."},{"end":579.45,"speaker":"S1","start":563.45,"text":"Please bring the declarations page from your auto policy. It's usually one or two pages and lists each coverage. You should also notify your own insurer of the accident if you haven't already, because most policies require prompt notice."},{"end":584.05,"speaker":"S2","start":580.05,"text":"I'll find it. And how do you get paid?"},{"end":603.7,"speaker":"S1","start":584.9,"text":"We work on a contingency fee. We receive thirty-three percent of the recovery if it settles before a lawsuit is filed, and forty percent if we file suit. You don't pay anything up front, and if we don't recover anything, you don't owe us a fee."},{"end":607.6,"speaker":"S2","start":604.8,"text":"Okay. I'd like to go forward."},{"end":625.4,"speaker":"S1","start":608.2,"text":"Great. Here's what happens next. I'll have my assistant, Marisol, send you the engagement agreement and medical authorizations to sign electronically today. Once they're signed, I will send a letter of representation to Ridgeway Mutual and to Quickfleet Courier by November 9."},{"end":629.05,"speaker":"S2","start":626.25,"text":"What do you need from me?"},{"end":646.95,"speaker":"S1","start":630.15,"text":"The property damage release you signed, your pay stubs and last year's tax return, all your medical bills, and the explanation of benefits forms. I'll have Marisol send you an email with that checklist so you don't have to remember it."},{"end":648.75,"speaker":"S2","start":647.55,"text":"Thank you."},{"end":673.2,"speaker":"S1","start":649.6,"text":"I also want to request the police report and ask the sheriff's office whether the deputy noted the tablet comment. That data can get overwritten if we don't ask quickly."},{"end":677.1,"speaker":"S2","start":674.3,"text":"I didn't know vans had that."},{"end":687.3,"speaker":"S1","start":677.7,"text":"Many commercial fleets do. It can show speed and braking right before impact. I'll send that preservation letter this week, by November 6."},{"end":688.95,"speaker":"S2","start":688.15,"text":"Okay."},{"end":701.25,"speaker":"S1","start":690.05,"text":"One more thing. Please don't post anything about the accident or your activities on social media. Insurance companies look at it and take things out of context."},{"end":706.65,"speaker":"S2","start":701.85,"text":"I'm not on social media much anyway, but I'll be careful."},{"end":711.9,"speaker":"S1","start":707.5,"text":"Good. Is there anything else you think I should know?"},{"end":722.6,"speaker":"S2","start":713,"text":"Only that my neurologist appointment is December 3, and Dr. Osei wants to see me again on December 10 to decide about surgery."},{"end":744.8,"speaker":"S1","start":723.2,"text":"Thank you, I'll note both dates. We'll want those records after each visit. I'll also make a note to the file summarizing today's consultation: the rear-end collision on August 22, the C5 C6 herniation and L4 L5 bulge, the concussion symptoms, the lost wages since August, and the upcoming neurology and spine appointments."},{"end":750.85,"speaker":"S2","start":745.65,"text":"Thank you, Mr. Adeyemi. I feel better knowing someone is handling this."},{"end":755.95,"speaker":"S1","start":751.95,"text":"That's what we're here for. Take care getting home."}],"user_notes":[]}

S3: Yes. I'll log that today.
Dana Reyes: What's the procedural posture of the cargo theft case?
S2: Answers were due October 30 and we filed ours on time for ACME Logistic Partners. Initial disclosures are due November 20. Delmar's counsel already sent interrogatories.
Dana Reyes: When are those responses due?
S2: Thirty days from October 22, so November 21. I'll need Victor to pull dispatch records, driver logs, and the GPS data for that tractor.

Dana Reyes: Okay. Helen, please send Victor Reyes an email listing the documents we need for the interrogatory responses: dispatch records, driver logs, GPS data, the rate confirmation with Tri-State Freight Partners, and any insurance notice they sent to their cargo insurer.
